name: quipendo
description: Quipendo: a read-only Chrome (MV3) extension and command line tool that copy your Quip folders and documents to Markdown files.
author: Aarjav

scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.e2e:firefox: npm run build:e2e:firefox && E2E_BROWSER=firefox vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.e2e:webkit: npm run build:e2e:safari && E2E_BROWSER=webkit vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run build && E2E_PROD=1 vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/production.e2e.test.ts
scripts.smoke:firefox: npm run build:firefox && E2E_PROD=1 E2E_BROWSER=firefox vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/production.e2e.test.ts
scripts.smoke:webkit: npm run build:safari && E2E_PROD=1 E2E_BROWSER=webkit vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/production.e2e.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:all && npm run verify-build
